shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,100p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -i -C 3 'calendar|date' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && sed -n '1,240p' src/App.tsx && cat AGENTS.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui | rg '/(date-components|uikit)/.*(INDEX|README|Calendar|DatePicker)' | head -100"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '215,234p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && sed -n '1,180p' src/main.tsx && rg --files | sort | head -100 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui"

/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/date-components versions --json && npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4 peerDependencies --json && npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@3 peerDependencies --json'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm view @gravity-ui/date-components@4 version peerDependencies --json && npm view @gravity-ui/date-utils version'

/bin/bash -lc "node -p \"JSON.stringify({dc:require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json').version,du:require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/package.json').version,ui:require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json').version})\" && find node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components -path '*/docs/INDEX.md' -o -path '*/README.md' | head -20 && rg -n -C 4 'Calendar|Required setup|styles|DatePicker|CalendarView' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/INDEX.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/build/docs/INDEX.md 2>/dev/null | head -160 && sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/components/Calendar.md && rg -n -C 4 'loadLocale|settings|dateTime\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/dist/docs/INDEX.md | head -120 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/package.json | head -100 && rg -n 'CalendarProps|interface Calendar|type Calendar' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components -g '*.d.ts' | head -40"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/Calendar/Calendar.d.ts && rg -n 'export declare function dateTime|declare const dateTime|format\\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils/dist -g '*.d.ts' | head -50 && cat tsconfig.json && sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/docs/INDEX.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 2 'spacing|--g-color-base-background|--g-color-text-primary|--g-color-line-generic' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -100 && rg -n 'interface CalendarStateOptions|onUpdate|value\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/useCalendarState.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/hooks/types.d.ts | head -60 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-utils | head -30"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'interface TextProps|type TextProps|as\\??:|color\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build -g '*Text*.d.ts' -g '*.d.ts' | head -100 && rg -n -- '--g-color-base-background|--g-color-base-generic|--g-color-base-simple-hover|--g-color-line-generic|--g-spacing-5|--g-border-radius-l' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles | head -80 && sed -n '1,220p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/types/props.d.ts 2>/dev/null"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'size_l|size_m|calendar__' node_modules/@gravity-ui/date-components/dist/esm/components/CalendarView/Calendar.css | head -100 && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/App.tsx src/main.tsx package.json | head -220"
/bin/bash -lc 'find dist -type f -delete && find dist -depth -type d -empty -delete && git diff --check && git status --short'
